limitations: Static decoding provides instruction boundaries and control edges, not translated instruction semantics.

Only observed HUNK overlay generations with a validated namespaced evidence record receive relocated range identities; this does not close unobserved loads.

Atlas v2 core addresses are not generation-scoped, so overlay recovery uses only entry/transfer observations with instruction ordinals and the latest matching validated load at or before that time; untimed coverage/layer addresses and pre-load observations never seed overlay code.

The current overlay evidence records successful LoadSeg ordinals but not unload/free ordinals. Latest-load mapping therefore distinguishes later reuse but does not prove that the selected generation was still live at the observation.
Generation-scoped overlay instructions and blocks are nested recovery metadata, not resident codegen input or a claim that the complete overlay call graph was observed.
Runtime-written and self-modifying code is outside this resident static artifact.
